<thought>Based on the molecular formula C6H15O2N, DBE = 0 and the presence of six methyl groups, a plausible structure is CN(C)CCOCCO (N,N‑dimethyl‑2‑(2‑hydroxyethoxy)ethanamine). This can be split into two connected fragments that recombine to give the full SMILES: the dimethylamino‑ethyl fragment “CN(C)CC” and the hydroxy‑ethoxy fragment “OCCO”. Both are valid SMILES strings and can be joined at the oxygen to reconstruct the target molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>['CN(C)CC', 'OCCO']</final_answer>
